name: Level_2 - Task_4
description: Evaluate the vibrational properties of bulk Palladium (Pd) by computing its phonon band structure and density of states (DOS). Start from a primitive face-centered cubic (FCC) unit cell with a lattice parameter of a = 3.89 Å. The MACE-MP-0 foundation model should be used as the ASE-compatible calculator to describe interatomic interactions. Compute the finite-displacement force constants using a finite-difference method with a 5 × 5 × 5 supercell and an atomic displacement delta of 0.05 Å. Assemble the dynamical matrix while enforcing the acoustic sum rule. Extract the phonon band structure along the high-symmetry Brillouin zone path "GXULGK" using 100 points, and compute the phonon DOS on a 20 × 20 × 20 k-point grid sampled over 100 points with a smearing width of 1e-3 eV. Finally, calculate the Zero-Point Energy (ZPE) by numerically integrating the sampled DOS ($ZPE = \frac{1}{2} \int E \cdot g(E) dE$) and return the result in eV.
